focus.ads: Pain point · ad creative · Facebook Ads

profiles.backend: Designs APIs, data models, and backend workflows with consistency, scale, and backward compatibility in mind.
profiles.frontend: Builds approachable interfaces, improves rendering, and keeps experiences consistent across states.
profiles.senior: Handles difficult logic and safe, focused changes; checks impact before implementation.
profiles.security: Reviews threat models, authentication, authorization, and sensitive data; reports evidence-backed risks.
profiles.testing: Builds reliable automated tests, isolated data, and evidence that makes failures reproducible.
profiles.reality: Evidence-based quality gate: checks acceptance criteria, tests, and remaining risk before release.
profiles.ceo: Sets priorities, delegates, and approves. Project changes and deployments require your confirmation.
profiles.socialCeo: Coordinates the social floor, assigns writing, images, and review. A post is not done until you confirm it.
profiles.director: Sets content pillars, the posting schedule, and the mix of sales versus value posts. Reviews quality before it reaches you.
profiles.copy: Writes Facebook captions: a short hook, scannable body, emoji as section marks, a clear CTA, and a tight hashtag set.
profiles.image: Writes English prompts that match the post, at 1:1, 4:5, or 16:9 for Facebook.
profiles.trend: Catches rising topics and searches on Facebook or Google and turns them into a timely post idea.
profiles.community: Drafts comment and Messenger replies in the brand voice, without inventing policy.
profiles.ads: Proposes ad angles around a pain point, with a headline and CTA to test on Facebook Ads.
profiles.carousel: Splits a post into 3–5 Facebook slides: problem, solution, and a CTA on the last slide.
